findings.title: R11 10 ohm in the U1 EN/UVLO divider: converter never turns on
findings.claim: With R10 100k and R11 10 ohm the EN/UVLO pin sees 2.6 mV at 26.4 V; turn-on would need about 12 kV.

findings.title: U6 MODE0 strap: pull-up and pull-down both fitted
findings.claim: The pin settles near half the I/O supply, between VIL and VIH, so the latched mode is undefined.

findings.title: U2 3V3 buck outside its example envelope, internal compensation, no Cff footprint
findings.claim: L4 is 4.7x the example inductance and COUT is half the example, with no way to add phase without rework.

not_published.action: Cff footprint across the top feedback resistor

findings.fix: Restore example L and COUT; add Cff and injection footprints.
findings.bench_test: Load step 10 to 90 percent with 1 us edges; Bode at 5 mV injection.

findings.title: I2C2 SDA and SCL have no pull-up to any supply
findings.claim: Open-drain bus with no pull-up never returns high.
findings.fix: Add 2.2k pull-ups to 3V3; check rise time with calc.i2c.

findings.title: D1 VRWM 24 V below the 26.4 V input maximum
findings.claim: The TVS conducts inside the normal input range.
findings.fix: Use the 30 V standoff part and recheck clamp against U1 abs max.

findings.title: C12 5 V bulk capacitor rated 6.3 V
findings.claim: At 5 V bias the 6.3 V part keeps a small fraction of its nominal value.
